Goldman Sachs expects five major U.S. cloud companies to increase AI infrastructure investment 54% to $1.2T in 2027, exceeding Wall Street forecasts.

•    Companies covered: The forecast includes AMZN, GOOGL, MSFT,ORCL, and META.
•    This-year spending: Goldman expects the five companies to spend about $800B this year.
•    Revenue requirement: The bank estimates hyperscalers need roughly $300B in annual AI-related revenue to break even.
•    Funding constraint: Growing financing requirements could limit how quickly the companies expand investment.
•    Buildout constraint: Infrastructure bottlenecks could also slow the pace of future spending growth.
